messages:
nina_partnerships: Heads up team - StratusLane sent new assets for the joint solution brief and marketplace tile. Need quick QA: logo clearspace, dark mode lockup, alt text, and whether the case study quote is compliant. Zip: https://stratuslane-cdn.com/sl-redwood-package.zip

arc_design: opening now. Do we have a preferred SVG width/height exports? I'll produce 24/48/96 px grid svgs + 2x pngs. Also will check kerning inside the logotype.

stratuslane_pm: quick note - included `stratus_logo_primary.svg`, `stratus_logo_reversed.svg`, `solution-brief-v1.pdf`, `case-study-july.pdf`, and `consent_statement_signed.pdf`.

assetbot: StratusLane uploaded consent_statement_signed.pdf (uploaded by stratuslane_pm)  1994567005

tim_legal: Thanks. I'll scan the consent doc. If it names Redwood and covers marketplace/marketing it's fine. One issue: the quote uses the customer's product name; we need to redact product SKU if it's PII or confidential.

anya_marketing: For the marketplace hero we need a 16:9 1200x675, alt text, and a 100-char headline. Also confirm whether we can repurpose the case study quote for the hero (needs to be <140 chars).

arc_design: Proposed alt text options: 1) "Engineers reviewing inference telemetry on a cloud dashboard; StratusLane and Redwood logos." 2) "Deployment metrics chart with team discussing results; co-branded logos in corner." Which preferred?

nina_partnerships: Go with option 1. Also add alt attribute to logo svg title.

stratuslane_pm: Confirmed option 1. Consent doc permits the quote. No headshots included.

tim_legal: Found consent doc: good. One edit request - change attribution from initials to full name + company. Also ask StratusLane to confirm trademark style (capitalization and ®/TM).

arc_design: I'll export `stratus_logo_24.svg`, `stratus_logo_48.svg`, `stratus_logo_96.svg`, `stratus_logo_white.svg`, plus PNGs - and I will add a READ_ME.txt with clearspace = 12px (equal to 50% of logotype height). Will also create a dark-tile variant with subtle outer glow to maintain contrast.

anya_marketing: Suggested hero headline: "Faster inference, lower cost with StratusLane + Redwood". Short pull quote (<=140): "Reduced inference cost by 42% while improving tail-latency." Attribution: " - Priya K., VP Eng, StratusLane". OK?

stratuslane_pm: Approved. Use full name: "Priya Kapoor, VP Engineering, StratusLane". No objections.

tim_legal: One more thing: please confirm alt text doesn't include personal names. Also we need a one-line citation line in the case study PDF: "Data and results provided by StratusLane, July 2026."

nina_partnerships: Action items: Arc (exports + dark tile) by EOD, Tim (final sign-off) in <24h>, Anya (CTA/headline finalize) by EOD tomorrow. If all green I'll schedule publishing next Wednesday. :calendar:

arc_design: Uploading now to shared folder: https://redwood-shared.s3.amazonaws.com/partnerships/stratuslane/exports/README.txt (contains export list & clearspace specs).

stratuslane_pm: Thanks everyone. We'll be on standby for any edits.

tim_legal: Done reviewing - final note added to the consent doc and stored in legal drive. All clear from legal. :white_check_mark:

anya_marketing: Final CTA: "See joint demo". Alt text confirmed. Ready to proceed.

nina_partnerships: Great - scheduling marketplace publish for Wednesday. Closing thread unless blockers. :thumbsup:
